description: A host's rule for each of its capabilities, by name: everybody's where none's set.

shell.description: A shell on its machine: its terminals (terminal ops) and Multiplex's, through a Bot's terminal tools (multiplex).

browser.description: Its Bots' Emission browsers: their tools' calls (emission), watching one (emission_watch) and a phone showing one (emission_serve).

providers.description: Its inference providers' models, run through the mesh (infer).

model_files.description: Its models' files, read through the mesh (files).

spawn.description: New chats and agents started on it (start, agent).

manage.description: Its chats as they are: listed, read, written in, stopped, renamed, archived, deleted, a Bot's tasks and memory. A chat's own rule (Access's chat) goes before this.

access.description: These rules changed (access_set). A head on its own machine, or one over ssh, may always.
